business_summary: NCS Testing Technology Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, and application of metal material testing technologies in China and internationally. It offers integrated testing services, such as chemical analysis, mechanical testing, nondestructive testing, corrosion testing, welding qualification, failure analysis, sample processing, and environmental reliability testing. The company also provides instruments and equipment, including direct reading spectrometer, scanning electron microscope, carbon and sulfur analyzer, oxygen, nitrogen and hydrogen analyzer, ICP spectrometer, ICP-MS, X-ray fluorescence spectrometer, material testing machine, nondestructive testing equipment, non-destructive pipe flaw detection equipment, non-destructive bar flaw detection equipment, and other non-destructive flaw detection equipment. In addition, it offers standard substances/samples, consumables and spare parts, and customization services; proficiency testing services; metrology and calibration services; corrosion protection services; certification evaluation services; and training consulting services. The company was founded in 1952 and is headquartered in Beijing, China. NCS Testing Technology Co., Ltd. is a subsidiary of China Iron & Steel Research Institute Group Co., Ltd.
